meta.event: Rasuwa – Bhote Koshi/Trishuli flash flood, 26 August 2026 (10 Bhadra 2083)
meta.disclaimer: Merged from two independently compiled sources: (1) Claude web research from Nepali government notices and news reporting, (2) a second research pass (Downloads/relief-drop-centers.json) that added a citizen volunteer network, precise GPS for several sites, and a Nuwakot venue list. Not an official government source. Call ahead before traveling with a large donation — points may wind down as needs shift.

important_notes: The Government of Nepal has NOT authorised any private organisation, group, or individual to independently collect cash or relief goods for this disaster ("one-door"/एकद्वार policy). The official_government_centers below are the sanctioned channels; the volunteer_network_centers section is a separate, informal citizen effort — useful but not government-verified infrastructure.

Nepal Police have warned of fake donation QR codes circulating on social media impersonating the PM Disaster Relief Fund. Verify the payee name reads exactly 'Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund' before scanning any QR.

coordinates_precision explains how reliable each lat/lng is: 'landmark' = precise, independently confirmed point; 'locality' = accurate to the neighbourhood/town center only; 'unverified' = no coordinate could be confirmed (approx_lat/approx_lng, if present, is an unconfirmed town-center estimate, not a real pin).

contacts.name: Sujan Kumari Bardewa (Administrative Officer, relief coordinator) — also reported as "Srijana Kumari Bardewa" in some outlets, likely the same person

official_government_centers.note: Organizations, companies and clubs running their own collection drives are asked to coordinate/hand over through this office. This office's own old building was the first improvised collection point right after the flood, before Samakhusi and Basundhara took over as the dedicated 24-hr public sites.

group_info.name: Independent citizen relief group (organized by Samaya Khadka)
group_info.origin: Started as a 5-person WhatsApp group after a Facebook post on 26 Aug 2026; grown to ~65 volunteers, unaffiliated with any party or organization
group_info.focus: Relief goods only (redirects cash offers to the PM Disaster Relief Fund). Deliberately focused on Rasuwa rather than Nuwakot, after confirming with Nuwakot authorities that Nuwakot had sufficient supplies.
group_info.confidence_note: This is an informal grassroots effort, not government-verified infrastructure — treat these as more likely to change or wind down than the official_government_centers above.

centers.name: Mirai Global Education and Visa Services

nuwakot_holding_distribution_centers.note: These are NOT donor drop-off points for people in Kathmandu — they are on-the-ground redistribution sites inside Nuwakot district where the local disaster committee stages relief for handout to survivors. Relevant only if traveling to Nuwakot directly. One source cites '13 holding centers' (9 in Vidur Municipality, 2 in Kispang, 1 in Suryagadhi, 1 in Belkotgadhi); a second source names 18 individual venues. The two lists don't fully reconcile — flagged as-is rather than forced into one count.
nuwakot_holding_distribution_centers.confidence: medium — named in news reporting, no coordinates, venue count inconsistent across sources
venues: Ranbhuwaneshwari Secondary School and Ward Office

ngo_channels.name: Nepal Red Cross Society Headquarters
ngo_channels.handles: Cash donations (donation.nrcs.org) and volunteer coordination; 200+ staff already deployed to affected districts with tarpaulins, blankets, sleeping mats, first aid kits and drinking water

municipal_fund_contributors.name: Pokhara Metropolitan City Office
municipal_fund_contributors.note: NOT a public drop-off point. Pokhara Metropolitan City itself donated NPR 4.5 million to the PM Relief Fund; local businesses/associations in Pokhara separately raised over NPR 4.1 million routed through the same fund.

cash_donation.warning: Government has publicly warned against personal/unofficial QR codes circulating on social media claiming to collect for flood victims. Verify against the official portal, and that the payee name reads exactly 'Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund', before sending money to any QR code.
cash_donation.note: Bank account numbers and live donation totals are deliberately excluded here — they change daily and would go stale in this file. Link out to the official portal instead.
